answer: A bond of 60% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in zephyr, and mirror reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 55 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vertex account. Each duplicate costs another 42 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
